found: Mottled ochre and sand coloured render with grey patches and a fine even grain. No streaks, no cracks, no flaking: it reads as a rough cast render in good condition and carries none of the weathering the recipe's name asks for. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature or watermark, and nothing that ties it to a particular building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
